subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart 54 embeddings & rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart - embeddings & rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)

Hi Sam - thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap so we have aligned notes and clear next steps. If I missed anything, please correct me inline.

What we heard (pain points):
- Search relevance is drifting for long-tail SKUs after catalog updates; manual tuning is high effort.
- Current rerank pipeline is slow and expensive: 600-900ms p95 end-to-end on average, spikes >1.5s during peak.
- Vector index growth and update patterns are the biggest operational concern (see index numbers below).

Current stack you described:
- Embeddings: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for experimentation; planning to standardize on an open model for cost control.
- Vector DB: Pinecone for production, a small FAISS service for experiments. Postgres for metadata and product signals.
- Serving: Node backend that calls vector DB + candidate reranker (lightweight transformer).

Key numbers / constraints you shared:
- Current index ~45M vectors (50-70 dim, mixed sparse/dense metadata).
- Ingest: nightly batch ~3-5M items, plus near-real-time updates ~400-1,000 items/min during catalog updates.
- Query volume: 120k queries/day, peak QPS ~45.
- Latency targets: target p95 end-to-end <=150ms for most queries; acceptable p95 <=250ms for complex reranks.
- Cost goal: reduce per-query embedding + retrieval cost by ~2-3x vs current OpenAI costs.

Success criteria for a pilot (what would make this win):
1) Demonstrable p95 latency <=150ms for the test query set (50-1000 queries/min).
2) Retrieval quality improvement on your relevance eval set (NDCG uplift vs baseline).
3) Operational plan for nightly reindexing <3 hours and near-real-time ingest with <5s propagation for high-priority SKUs.

Suggested next steps (we proposed):
- We will produce a short PoC plan and SOW draft (1 week) with test dataset requirements.
- Technical deep-dive with your infra/search engineer to review indexing/ingest (Marissa + Dev suggested).
- Provide a sample cost/latency projection for a 45M vector index under both Pinecone and a Redwood-managed FAISS/quantized config.

Attachments: attached PDF with my notes + sample index export you can share internally (brightcart-discovery-notes.pdf, sample-index-stats.csv).

Open questions for you:
- What is your SLA requirement for write propagation during catalog updates? (you mentioned "near real-time" but want specific SLOs).
- Do you have any hard constraints on model choice (no external APIs, only self-hosted/open models)?

Thanks again - I'll follow up with the PoC/outreach timeline by EOD Friday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions - Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BrightCart - embeddings & rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)

Thanks Marissa - this looks right. A couple clarifications and extra detail from our side: 

- Index size: the 45M is our cold catalog (historic SKUs). Active catalog for the storefront is ~12M vectors. We need solution to handle both without blowing up cost.
- Vector dims: currently 768 for the OpenAI embeddings; we were experimenting with 1536 on a subset. We're open to quantized models that get us similar quality at lower cost.
- Ingest: nightly full reindex of product metadata + images (~4M new/updated vectors). Real-time changes are smaller but bursty (the 1k/min number happens during promotions).
- Query patterns: about 70% are short queries (product search), 30% are long/natural language queries used for merchandising. Rerank is applied only to top-200 candidates.

SLOs: For the pilot we need p95 <=200ms end-to-end and p99 <350ms. If the PoC looks good we can tighten to your 150ms target.

We can share a small sample of anonymized product embeddings + relevance labels next week (will use your Drive link).

Happy to jump on the tech deep-dive - can you do Wed 10/07 10:00am PT? I'll loop in our infra lead (TBD).

Sam
Head of Search & Relevance
BrightCart
sam.peterson@brightcart.com

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BrightCart - embeddings & rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)

Quick note from infra/solutions:

- For a 45M vector index, quantized FAISS on 4-8 A100 GPUs with sharding should meet the latency targets for top-50 rerank and be significantly cheaper than remote embeddings. We'll include a cost model in the PoC.
- For ingestion: we recommend a hybrid approach - nightly bulk for the cold catalog and a streaming path for high-priority SKU updates (Kafka -> small batch writer -> index). That will keep propagation <5s for prioritized items.
- We will not use hosted embedding APIs in the default PoC; instead propose a self-hosted open model (quantized) unless you have a strict restriction. Please confirm.

I'll be on the Wed deep-dive and can bring initial benchmark scripts.

Cheers,
Rishi
